details: npm user 'priyashareek' published this package in a dependency confusion campaign against the internal scopes @accenturecodefoundry and @newspage. The publisher used 99.99.x versions to outrank the internal packages. 0.0.0-stage and 99.99.1 are empty placeholders. From 99.99.2 on, a 'preinstall' hook runs 'node index.js || true'. In 99.99.2, index.js hex-encodes the hostname and current username and sends them to https://accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net/test?h=<hostname>&u=<username>. Versions 99.99.4 and 99.99.41 send a plain install-time beacon to the same host (/async and /mfe). Each beacon reveals the victim's egress IP and tells the operator the dependency confusion worked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
